Persistent, silent brief that stays on the lock screen
New HIGH-impact headlines and pre-release heads-ups
Put Pulse on your lock screen

Option A: One UI lock screen
1. Lock the phone, wake the screen, and long-press an empty area of the lock screen (or Settings → Wallpaper and style → Lock screen).
2. Tap the widget area → look for Cannuran Pulse in the list.

Option B: Good Lock → LockStar (always works on Galaxy)
1. Install Good Lock from the Galaxy Store, then add the LockStar module.
2. Turn LockStar on → tap the lock-screen preview → Widgets / Add widget → Cannuran Pulse.
3. Resize it: about 4×2 for the slim strip, 4×4 or taller for the full panel with quotes and headlines.

Option C: the lock-screen card (no setup)
Keep "Lock-screen card" on in Pulse. It stays on the lock screen and updates with every brief.

Keep it alive
• In Pulse → Device, tap Fix on every row (notifications, battery, precise alarms).
• Settings → Notifications → Lock screen notifications → show content, so the card isn't hidden.
